summary: Examples of known_hosts: adding a key from a local file to the system-wide file, adding a key with hostname and IP, and adding a host with a custom SSH port.
questions: How do I add a host key for a server on port 2222?
How do I load a host key from a file in my repo?
How do I add a host key to /etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts?

answer_card.title: known_hosts examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.known_hosts:
    path: /etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts
    name: foo.com.invalid
    key: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.file', 'pubkeys/foo.com.invalid') }}"
- ansible.builtin.known_hosts:
    name: host1.example.com
    key: host1.example.com,10.9.8.77 ssh-rsa AAAA...
    path: /etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts
- ansible.builtin.known_hosts:
    name: '[host1.example.com]:2222'
    key: '[host1.example.com]:2222 ssh-rsa AAAA...'
```
